title: 2x2 native circuits under noiseless sampling and the Quantinuum noise models (prompts/35 T2 + T3)

criteria.name: N1 per-state 5 sigma test |n_s/N - p_s| <= 5 sqrt(p_s(1-p_s)/N), p_s >= 1e-3, on all 28 noiseless circuits; fraction outside the exact support
criteria.threshold: 28 circuits; 0 failures (Bonferroni: P(any |z| > 5 | no bug) < 6e-7 x states tested); outside 0

criteria.name: N2 noiseless SKQD at the H0_2x2 plan of record (133907 shots): recall of S999 >= 0.9 in both sectors, E0 inside the Kato-Temple (B=0) / Weinstein (B=1) interval, E_R >= E0 - 1e-9

N3 every f-cell (28 circuits x the scenarios run) has f_hit, its 95 % Garwood interval, f0, r_nc and its seed; E1 all-circuit reference hits against the Poisson 95 % band at the 2x3 r_nc (information)
criteria.threshold: complete; band = information ('tension' does not fail)

criteria.name: N4 every plan-of-record run reports recall, E_R, the certificate, the accepted fraction, and E_R >= E0 - 1e-9 (a violation is a STOP)
N5 qpu_seconds == 0, hqc == 0; seeds and s/shot recorded; scenarios_run listed

seed_rules.T2: 35 000 000 + 1000 c + chunk (c = index in the sorted id list)
seed_rules.T3_fcells: 35 200 000 + 1000 s + c (s = scenario index in SCENARIOS, c = index in the sorted ids)
seed_rules.QV_2x4: no random numbers in slot runs (statevectors only); the dry run's sampling is not used

data.what_pass_means: the 28 frozen 2x2 native circuits sample their exact distributions noiselessly and run through the Quantinuum-class noise scenarios E1-E7 with every number recorded; a model statement, not a device statement

noiseless.seed_rule: 35 000 000 + 1000 c + chunk (c = index in the sorted id list)
noiseless.shots_rule: max(20000, plan-of-record shots of the circuit) (the f = 1 reference reads the first plan shots)

description.source: emulator noise_model.html linear_dephasing_rate (Pauli-Z with probability rate x duration); rate 0.0028 /s = data/quantinuum/devices_20261002.json memory_model.memory_rate_per_qubit_per_s.quantinuum_h2_1; t_round = memory_model.t_round_scenarios_s
not_modelled: the coherent quadratic dephasing sin^2(f d / 2), f = 0.043
description.aer_convention: depolarizing_error(p, n): rho -> (1-p) rho + p I/2^n; fault probability 15p/16 (n=2), 3p/4 (n=1); the published number is Aer's p (the A6 / CF_traj convention).  The vendor emulator's p is the probability of a non-identity Pauli (16/15 resp. 4/3 times larger fault rate in Aer's convention): not converted.
description.placement:
(documented choice, prompts/33 A3): layers are the ASAP depth over rzz; on a qubit q the
    site of layer L is appended right after q's own rzz of layer L when q takes part in it, and
    otherwise right before q's next rzz (after the one-qubit gates in between), the sites of layers
    after q's last rzz before the measurements.  Every qubit gets exactly one site per layer, so a
    circuit gets n_qubits x n_layers sites (Z flips of one qubit commute with each other).
